verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform like mParticle, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only conventional human-oriented docs pages, with no mention of llms.txt, markdown docs for LLMs, or agent-specific documentation. The AI-assisted audience-building claims are a different feature and do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
